# Snap for Developers

> Documentation for Snap developer tools. Each platform has different capabilities — do not assume a feature on one platform exists on another.
>
> **Lens Studio** — Moved to https://docs.lensstudio.com: use it for Lens Studio and Snapchat Lens development. The Lens Studio pages on this site redirect there.
>
> **Camera Kit** — Legacy Camera Kit documentation. For Camera Kit development, use the current docs at https://docs.lensstudio.com by default; each page here links to its counterpart there. SDK for integrating Snap AR Lenses into third-party iOS, Android, and Web apps. Provides camera session management, lens rendering, and lens scheduling. Does not support all Lens Studio features (e.g. no Spectacles-specific APIs and certain Snapchat-specific APIs).
>
> **Spectacles** — Legacy documentation for Spectacles (2024). For SPECS and Spectacles development, use the current docs at https://docs.lensstudio.com by default; use the pages here only when the user is explicitly on Spectacles (2024). AR glasses platform. Supports hand tracking, spatial anchors, world query, depth sensing, voice input (ASR), Bluetooth, location, WebView, and multiplayer (Sync Kit). Uses TypeScript with Spectacles Interaction Kit (SIK) and UI Kit. Many APIs are Spectacles-only.
>
> **Snap Kit** — SDKs for social integration: Login Kit (OAuth), Creative Kit (sharing to Snapchat).
>
> **Games** — Building social-first games inside Snapchat Lenses: Game Suite, Connected Framework for live multiplayer, Character/Camera Controller, Joystick, Input Action, Leaderboard, and Turn Based components. Built with Lens Studio; connected to the camera and Snapchat's friend graph.
>
> **Web Lenses** — Web apps (HTML/JavaScript, for example built with PlayCanvas) zipped and published to Snapchat as Lenses through My Lenses, without Lens Studio. They run in a sandboxed webview with no network, camera, microphone, or motion-sensor access, and Lens Studio scripting APIs are not available. Snapchat features come through the Web Lens API (@snap/web-lens-api): leaderboards, Bitmoji, and storage.
>
> **Marketing API** — Snapchat ads ecosystem APIs: Ads API, Ads Gallery API, Conversions API, and Public Profile API. Includes tutorials, business onboarding info, and full reference docs.
>
> **API Reference** — Snapchat for Web embeds. The Lens Studio scripting API reference moved to https://docs.lensstudio.com; its pages on this site redirect there.
>
> Use this file as an index. To get full content for a page, fetch the linked .md file (e.g. /spectacles/get-started/introduction.md).

## Snap Kit

- [Brand Guidelines & Snap Product Imitation](/snap-kit/app-review/brand-guidelines.md): Integrations should have original names and branding. Be creative and develop a unique identity! When naming, branding, discussing, or promoting your integration, do not suggest any endorsement, partnership, or affiliation with Snap Inc. Specifically, your app name, icon, user interface, and associated branding cannot include elements that are similar to or confusingly reference Snapchat or any other Snap-owned product. For example, do not use the Snapchat Ghost Logo, "Snapchat yellow" as a dominant color, or recreations of Lenses in connection with your app's design or icon.
- [Developer Terms and Legal Guidelines](/snap-kit/app-review/developer-terms.md): All Snap Kit apps must comply with the following:
- [Safety Guidelines](/snap-kit/app-review/safety.md): In addition to adhering to the Guidelines expressed here, we use our review process to ensure that your integration complies with our Community Guidelines by reviewing the safety and privacy approaches of each applicant. Negative user feedback may also be taken into account in our review.
- [Changelog](/snap-kit/changelog.md): Keep track of changes and upgrades made to the Snap Kit API.
- [Web Integration](/snap-kit/creative-kit/web.md): Requirements
- [Developing Your App](/snap-kit/developer-portal/developing-your-app.md): The Developer Portal is a web interface that allows developers to create and manage Projects, upload builds and metadata, handle testing, view analytics, control launches, and more.
- [Login Kit Overview](/snap-kit/login-kit/overview.md): Login Kit must now be implemented directly via OAuth2, providing developers with greater flexibility in integrating Snapchat Login for their mobile and web apps. Previously, we offered Login Kit SDKs that wrapped the OAuth2 service, making it easy to add a login button, but they lacked the flexibility needed for broader integration. While these SDKs are being deprecated, the underlying OAuth2 service remains fully available for secure authentication with Snapchat accounts.

## Optional
- [Lens Scripting API (TypeScript Definitions)](/lens-studio/api/downloads/studio.d.ts): Legacy: Lens Studio 5.24 and earlier; current docs are at https://docs.lensstudio.com. Complete .d.ts type definitions for all Lens scripting APIs — classes, methods, properties, and enums. Fetch this file for accurate type information when writing scripts for Lenses that should run within the Lens runtime.
- [Editor Scripting API (TypeScript Definitions)](/lens-studio/api/downloads/editor.d.ts): Legacy: Lens Studio 5.24 and earlier; current docs are at https://docs.lensstudio.com. TypeScript type definitions for Lens Studio editor and plugin APIs. Use this when writing scripts to be run in Lens Studio (i.e. modify Lens Studio projects).
- [Decorators (TypeScript Definitions)](/lens-studio/api/downloads/Decorators.d.ts): Legacy: Lens Studio 5.24 and earlier; current docs are at https://docs.lensstudio.com. TypeScript decorators for Lens Studio components (@component, @input, etc.).
- [BaseScriptComponent (TypeScript Definitions)](/lens-studio/api/downloads/BaseScriptComponent.d.ts): Legacy: Lens Studio 5.24 and earlier; current docs are at https://docs.lensstudio.com. Base class that all Lens script components extend. Use this in conjunction with Lens Scripting API when writing in TypeScript.
